Implement the following plan:

# Plan: Add Traditional Chinese Input Method Installation

## Context

Add an opt-in option during `chezmoi init` to install Traditional Chinese input methods. On macOS, this installs McBopomofo (via cask) and RIME/Squirrel (via cask). On Ubuntu Desktop, this installs ibus-rime (via apt). Install only — no RIME config deployment. Only available on desktop profiles (macos, macos_intel, ubuntu_desktop).

## Files to Modify

### 1. `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` — Add prompt
Add after the `installBrewApps` line:
```
# 是否安裝繁體中文輸入法 (McBopomofo + RIME)
installInputMethod = {{ promptBoolOnce . "installInputMethod" "Install Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME)" false }}
```

### 2. `Dockerfile` — Add ARG + prompt flag
- Add `ARG CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD=false` (line ~18)
- Add `--promptBool "Install Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME)=${CHEZMOI_INSTALL_INPUT_METHOD}"` to `chezmoi init`

### 3. Create `dot_ansible/roles/input_method/tasks/main.yml` — New ansible role

**macOS tasks:**
- Check if McBopomofo is installed (`/Library/Input Methods/McBopomofo.app`)
- Install McBopomofo via `community.general.homebrew_cask: name: mcbopomofo`
- Check if Squirrel (RIME) is installed (`/Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app`)
- Install Squirrel via `community.general.homebrew_cask: name: squirrel`

**Linux (Ubuntu Desktop) tasks:**
- Install `ibus-rime` via apt (`become: true`, `tags: [sudo]`)
- Note: ibus is the default input framework on Ubuntu Desktop

### 4. `dot_ansible/playbooks/macos.yml` — Add role entry
```yaml
    - role: input_method
      tags: [input_method]
```

### 5. `dot_ansible/playbooks/linux.yml` — Add role entry
Same as above.

### 6. `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` — Wire up

**Add hash comment** (after existing role hashes):
```
# input_method: {{ include "dot_ansible/roles/input_method/tasks/main.yml" | sha256sum }}
```

**Add conditional tag** (after `python_uv_tools` block, ~line 81):
```bash
{{ $installInputMethod := false }}{{ if hasKey . "installInputMethod" }}{{ $installInputMethod = .installInputMethod }}{{ end -}}
{{ if $installInputMethod -}}
TAGS="${TAGS},input_method"
{{ end -}}
```

Only append for desktop profiles — but since the tag is only added conditionally and the role tasks use `when:` OS checks, no extra profile gating needed. The prompt itself signals it's for desktop use.

### 7. `README.md` — Update documentation
- Add `installInputMethod` to the "Optional Components" table (default: false)
- Add `input_method` tag to "What You Get > Tools" section: `McBopomofo, RIME (Squirrel on macOS, ibus-rime on Linux)`

### 8. `CLAUDE.md` — Update documentation
- Add `input_method` to the "Available Tags" table
- Add to "Profiles" section noting it's optional (desktop only)

## Verification

```bash

ANSIBLE_CONFIG=dot_ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook --syntax-check dot_ansible/playbooks/macos.yml
ANSIBLE_CONFIG=dot_ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook --syntax-check dot_ansible/playbooks/linux.yml

# Dry run (macOS)
cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml --tags "input_method" --check

# Test chezmoi template rendering
chezmoi execute-template < .chezmoi.toml.tmpl
```

 `./README.md`

```text
     1→# dotfiles
     2→
     3→Cross-platform development environment setup using **chezmoi** + **ansible**.
     4→
     5→- **chezmoi**: manages config files (dotfiles)
     6→- **ansible**: installs system dependencies and tools
     7→
     8→## Prerequisites
     9→
    10→- [chezmoi](https://www.chezmoi.io/install/)
    11→- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) (for ansible)
    12→
    13→## Architecture
    14→
    15→```mermaid
    16→flowchart TB
    17→    subgraph Bootstrap["1. Bootstrap"]
    18→        BREW[Homebrew macOS]
    19→        UV[uv] --> ANS[ansible]
    20→        MISE[mise]
    21→    end
    22→
    23→    subgraph Chezmoi["2. chezmoi apply"]
    24→        DOT[Config files<br/>~/.gitconfig, ~/.config/]
    25→        ANSDIR[~/.ansible/]
    26→        BREWFILE[Brewfiles<br/>~/.config/homebrew/]
    27→    end
    28→
    29→    subgraph Ansible["3. Ansible Playbooks"]
    30→        BASE[base]
    31→        ZSH[zsh]
    32→        NVIM[neovim]
    33→        DEVTOOLS[devtools]
    34→        UVTOOLS[python_uv_tools]
    35→        CARGO[rust_cargo_tools]
    36→    end
    37→
    38→    subgraph BrewBundle["4. Brew Bundle opt-in"]
    39→        CASKS[GUI Apps]
    40→        MAS[App Store]
    41→    end
    42→
    43→    Bootstrap --> Chezmoi --> Ansible
    44→    Chezmoi -.-> BrewBundle
    45→    MISE -.->|Node.js, Rust| NVIM
    46→    MISE -.->|Rust| CARGO
    47→    UV -.->|Python tools| UVTOOLS
    48→    BREW -.->|casks| CASKS
    49→```
    50→
    51→## Quick Setup
    52→
    53→```bash
    54→# One-liner to initialize and apply (installs chezmoi to ~/.local/bin)
    55→export GITHUB_USERNAME=daviddwlee84
    56→sh -c "$(curl -fsLS get.chezmoi.io)" -- -b "$HOME/.local/bin" init --apply git@github.com:$GITHUB_USERNAME/dotfiles.git
    57→```
    58→
    59→This automatically:
    60→
    61→1. Bootstraps Homebrew (macOS/Linux), uv, mise, ansible
    62→2. Deploys all config files
    63→3. Runs ansible playbooks (git, ripgrep, fd, neovim, etc.)
    64→4. Runs brew bundle (if `installBrewApps` enabled)
    65→
    66→### Optional Components
    67→
    68→During `chezmoi init`, you'll be prompted for optional installs:
    69→
    70→| Option | Default | Description |
    71→|--------|---------|-------------|
    72→| `installCodingAgents` | true | Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, td, sidecar, specify-cli, etc. |
    73→| `installBitwarden` | false | Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) + Desktop app (desktop profiles) with SSH agent auto-detection |
    74→| `installPythonUvTools` | true | Python CLI tools via uv (mlflow, litellm, sqlit-tui, etc.) |
    75→| `installBrewApps` | false | GUI apps via Homebrew Brewfile (casks, mas) |
    76→| `noRoot` | false | Skip sudo-requiring tasks (for servers without root access) |
    77→
    78→To change options later: `chezmoi init --force`
    79→
    80→## What You Get
    81→
    82→### Config Files
    83→
    84→- `~/.gitconfig` - Git configuration
    85→- `~/.config/nvim/` - Neovim (LazyVim) configuration
    86→- `~/.config/uv/uv.toml` - uv package manager config
    87→- `~/.cargo/config.toml` - Cargo registry mirror config (GFW)
    88→- `~/.npmrc` - npm registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
    89→- `~/.config/.bunfig.toml` - Bun global registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
    90→- `~/.config/alacritty/` - Alacritty terminal config
    91→- `~/.config/starship.toml` - Starship cross-shell prompt config
    92→- `~/.config/direnv/direnvrc` - direnv helper functions, including `.venv`-aware Python activation
    93→- `~/.config/yazi/` - Yazi file manager config (v0.3.3+ syntax, [docs](https://yazi-rs.github.io/docs/configuration/overview/))
    94→  - `yazi.toml` - Main config with open rules and openers (`o`/`O`)
    95→  - `keymap.toml`, `theme.toml` - Optional customization files (stubs provided)
    96→- `~/.claude/` - Claude Code settings
    97→- `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` - Global SpecStory defaults for `specstory run` across all projects
    98→- `~/.tmux.conf` - Tmux configuration with TPM plugins
    99→- `~/.local/bin/x` - Cross-platform terminal wrapper for `copy` / `paste` / `open`
   100→- `~/.config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` - Sesh keybinding (Ctrl+A for tmux session switcher)
   101→- `~/.config/zsh/tools/36_pueue.zsh` - Pueue queue summary helper (`pqsum`)
   102→- `~/.config/zsh/tools/28_tldr.zsh` - `tldrf` helper with `TLDR_LANGUAGES` fallback order
   103→- `~/.config/zsh/tools/95_bitwarden.zsh` - Bitwarden CLI completion + SSH agent socket auto-detection
   104→- `~/.ssh/config` - SSH main config skeleton (create-only: `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` + conservative `Host *` defaults)
   105→- `~/.ssh/config.d/00-defaults` - SSH global defaults stub (commented examples only)
   106→- `~/.ssh/config.d/git` - SSH host entries for `github.com` and `gitlab.com` with commented multi-account/Bitwarden examples
   107→- `~/.config/tmuxp/claude-sidecar.yaml` - tmuxp workspace for Claude + Sidecar
   108→- `~/.config/zellij/layouts/claude-sidecar.kdl` - Zellij layout for Claude + Sidecar
   109→- `~/.config/homebrew/` - Brewfiles for GUI apps (macOS casks + mas) plus selected CLI formulas (e.g., `tailscale`)
   110→
   111→SSH files are managed as create-only templates: if `~/.ssh/config` already exists, it is not overwritten. In that case, add `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` to your existing config manually to load the managed snippets.
   112→
   113→### Tools (via ansible)
   114→
   115→- **Base**: git, curl, ripgrep, fd, just, build tools
   116→- **Neovim**: >= 0.11.2 with LazyVim dependencies
   117→- **LazyVim deps**: fzf, lazygit, tree-sitter-cli, Node.js
   118→- **DuckDB CLI**: `duckdb` (Homebrew on macOS, official installer on Linux)
   119→- **rclone**: cloud storage sync CLI (Homebrew on macOS, official downloads on Linux)
   120→- **Coding Agents** (optional): Claude Code, Codex CLI, CodexBar, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, SpecStory, Happy, OpenChamber, td, sidecar, specify-cli
   121→- **Bitwarden** (optional): Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) via npm, Desktop app (snap/deb on Linux, cask on macOS) on desktop profiles, with zsh completion and SSH agent auto-detection
   122→- **Docker**: OrbStack (macOS) or Docker Engine (Linux)
   123→- **Cargo tools**: pueue (process queue manager)
   124→- **GUI Apps** (macOS): terminals, editors, browsers, network tools, utilities via Brewfile (Tailscale Desktop via Mac App Store `mas`, avoids pkg sudo prompt; Tailscale CLI via `brew "tailscale"` in shared Brewfile)
   125→
   126→### Bootstrap (installed before ansible)
   127→- **Homebrew** (macOS): Package manager for macOS
   128→- **uv**: Python package manager for ansible
   129→- **mise**: Runtime manager for Node.js and Rust (ensures latest versions)
   130→- **Dev tools**: bat, eza, git-delta, git-graph, tldr, thefuck, zoxide, direnv, yazi, tmux+tpm, sesh, zellij, btop, htop
   131→- **Starship**: Cross-shell prompt (replaces oh-my-zsh theme)
   132→- **Python tools (via uv)**: thefuck, apprise, sqlit-tui, dotenv, git-filter-repo, mlflow, litellm, tmuxp
   133→- **NerdFonts**: Hack Nerd Font for terminal emulators
   134→
   135→## Supported Platforms
   136→
   137→| Platform | Package Manager | Notes |
   138→|----------|-----------------|-------|
   139→| macOS | Homebrew | Full support |
   140→| Ubuntu Desktop | apt + snap | Full support |
   141→| Ubuntu Server | apt + snap | Full support |
   142→| Ubuntu Server (no root) | GitHub binaries + mise + cargo + uv | `noRoot=true`, tools installed to `~/.local/bin` |
   143→
   144→## Manual Commands
   145→
   146→```bash
   147→chezmoi diff          # Preview changes
   148→chezmoi apply         # Apply config files
   149→chezmoi cd            # Go to source directory
   150→
   151→# Re-run ansible manually
   152→cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml
   153→```
   154→
   155→## Docker Testing
   156→
   157→Test the full dotfiles setup on a bare Ubuntu machine:
   158→
   159→```bash
   160→# Build and run test suite
   161→just docker-test
   162→
   163→# Interactive devbox shell
   164→just docker-run
   165→
   166→# Build specific profiles
   167→just docker-desktop    # Ubuntu desktop profile
   168→just docker-china      # China mirror profile
   169→```
   170→
   171→## Development with justfile
   172→
   173→This project uses [just](https://github.com/casey/just) as a command runner:
   174→
   175→```bash
   176→just                  # List all commands
   177→just lint             # Ansible syntax check
   178→just check            # Full lint + dry-run
   179→just docker-build     # Build Docker image
   180→just info             # Show system info
   181→```
   182→
   183→## Customization
   184→
   185→See [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) for development guide, [docs/ansible.md](docs/ansible.md) for ansible customization, [docs/tools/direnv.md](docs/tools/direnv.md) for `.venv`-aware direnv usage, [docs/tools/specstory.md](docs/tools/specstory.md) for SpecStory configuration, [docs/tools/td_sidecar.md](docs/tools/td_sidecar.md) for td/sidecar usage, and [docs/tools/specify_cli.md](docs/tools/specify_cli.md) for Specify CLI.
   186→
```
</details></tool-use>

```yaml
---
# Input method role - Traditional Chinese input methods
# macOS: McBopomofo + Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask
# Linux: ibus-rime via apt

# =============================================================================
# macOS: McBopomofo
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if McBopomofo is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/McBopomofo.app
  register: mcbopomofo_check

- name: Install McBopomofo via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not mcbopomofo_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: mcbopomofo
    state: present

# =============================================================================
# macOS: Squirrel (RIME)
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if Squirrel (RIME) is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app
  register: squirrel_check

- name: Install Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not squirrel_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: squirrel
    state: present

# =============================================================================
# Linux: ibus-rime
# =============================================================================

- name: Install ibus-rime (Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: ibus-rime
    state: present
    update_cache: true

```
